import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 50;
    static final int MAXM = 50;
    static final int MAXK = 50;
    static final int T = MAXN + MAXK + 1;
    static int N_ = MAXN * T + 1;
    static int M_ = MAXK + (MAXM * 2 * MAXK + MAXN) * (T - 1);
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static int[] dist = new int[N_];
    static int[] parent_kk = new int[N_];
    static int[] parent_bb = new int[N_];
    static int[] heap = new int[1 + N_];
    static int[] index_in_heap = new int[N_];
    static int heap_size;

    static class Edge {
        Edge next;
        int j;
        Edge() {}
    }

    static Edge[] adj = new Edge[MAXN];
    static Edge[] adj_ = new Edge[N_];

    static int[] u_list = new int[M_];
    static int[] v_list = new int[M_];
    static int[] uv_list = new int[M_];
    static int[] cost = new int[M_];
    static int[] cost_ = new int[M_];
    static int[] capacity = new int[M_ * 2];

    static int n_, m_;
    static int[] ii = new int[MAXK];

    static int get_next_index(int i) {
        i <<= 1;
        if (i > heap_size) return 0;
        if (i < heap_size && (dist[heap[i + 1]] < dist[heap[i]] || (dist[heap[i + 1]] == dist[heap[i]] && parent_kk[heap[i + 1]] < parent_kk[heap[i]]))) return i + 1;
        return i;
    }

    static void heapify_up(int u) {
        int i = index_in_heap[u], j;
        while (i > 1 && (dist[u] < dist[heap[j = i / 2]] || (dist[u] == dist[heap[j]] && parent_kk[u] < parent_kk[heap[j]]))) {
            heap[iq[heap[j]] = i] = heap[j];
            i = j;
        }
        index_in_heap[u] = i;
        heap[i] = u;
    }

    static void heapify_down(int u) {
        int i = index_in_heap[u], j;
        while ((j = get_next_index(i)) != 0 && (dist[heap[j]] < dist[u] || (dist[heap[j]] == dist[u] && parent_kk[heap[j]] < parent_kk[u]))) {
            heap[iq[heap[j]] = i] = heap[j];
            i = j;
        }
        index_in_heap[u] = i;
        heap[i] = u;
    }

    static void push(int u) {
        index_in_heap[u] = ++heap_size;
        heapify_up(u);
    }

    static int pop() {
        int u = heap[1], v = heap[heap_size--];
        index_in_heap[v] = 1;
        heapify_down(v);
        return u;
    }

    static void add_edge(int i, int j) {
        Edge e = new Edge();
        e.j = j;
        e.next = adj[i];
        adj[i] = e;
    }

    static void add_edge_(int i, int h) {
        Edge e = new Edge();
        e.j = h;
        e.next = adj_[i];
        adj_[i] = e;
    }

    static int get_next_index(int i) {
        i <<= 1;
        if (i > heap_size) return 0;
        if (i < heap_size && (dist[heap[i + 1]] < dist[heap[i]] || (dist[heap[i + 1]] == dist[heap[i]] && parent_kk[heap[i + 1]] < parent_kk[heap[i]]))) return i + 1;
        return i;
    }

    static void dijkstra(int s) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, 0, n_, INF);
        dist[s] = 0;
        push(s);
        while (heap_size > 0) {
            int u = pop();
            for (Edge l = adj_[u]; l != null; l = l.next) {
                int h_ = l.j, h = h_ >> 1, v = u ^ uv_list[h], p;
                if (capacity[h_]) {
                    p = dist[u] + (((h_ & 1) == 0) ? cost[h] : -cost[h]);
                    if (dist[v] == INF) {
                        dist[v] = p;
                        parent_kk[v] = parent_kk[u] + 1;
                        parent_bb[v] = h_;
                        push(v);
                    } else if (dist[v] > p || (dist[v] == p && parent_kk[v] > parent_kk[u] + 1)) {
                        dist[v] = p;
                        parent_kk[v] = parent_kk[u] + 1;
                        parent_bb[v] = h_;
                        heapify_up(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void connect(int u, int v, int cap, int cst) {
        int h = m_++;
        u_list[h] = u; v_list[h] = v; uv_list[h] = u ^ v; cost[h] = cst;
        capacity[h << 1] = cap; add_edge_(u, h << 1); add_edge_(v, (h << 1) ^ 1);
    }

    static void augment(int s, int t) {
        for (int u = t; u != s; u ^= uv_list[parent_bb[u]]) {
            int h_ = parent_bb[u], h = h_ >> 1;
            capacity[h_]--;
            capacity[h_ ^ 1]++;
        }
    }

    static int max_flow(int s, int t) {
        System.arraycopy(cost, 0, cost_, 0, cost.length);
        while (true) {
            dijkstra(s);
            if (dist[t] == INF) break;
            augment(s, t);
            for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
                int u = u_list[h], v = v_list[h];
                if (dist[u] != INF && dist[v] != INF) {
                    cost_[h] += dist[u] - dist[v];
                }
            }
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
            total += cost[h] * capacity[h << 1];
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;
        int[] ii = new int[MAXK];

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++) {
            ii[h] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
        }

        for (int h = 0; h < m; h++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int i = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int j = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            add_edge(i, j);
            add_edge(j, i);
        }

        int t = n + k + 1;
        N_ = n * t + 1;
        m_ = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s;
                for (Edge l = adj[i]; l != null; l = l.next) {
                    int j = l.j;
                    int v = j * t + s + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                        connect(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s, v = u + 1;
                connect(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        }

        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++) {
            connect(N_ - 1, ii[h] * t + 0, 1, 0);
        }

        System.out.println(max_flow(N_ - 1, 0 * t + t - 1));
    }
}
